skill.name: zendesk-automation
skill.description: Automate Zendesk ticket, user, organization, and reply workflows through the Rube MCP and Composio integration.
skill.summary: Manage common Zendesk support operations through current Rube MCP tool schemas.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The 69 shell-execution alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around tool and parameter names. The skill introduces a real external service boundary and lacks safeguards for destructive, privileged, and customer-visible actions.

remediation.issue: Ticket deletion is permanent, but the workflow does not require user confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation that includes the ticket ID and current subject before calling the deletion tool.

remediation.issue: User creation can assign agent or admin roles and mark email addresses as verified.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict privileged role and verification changes to authorized requests, then require explicit confirmation before execution.

remediation.issue: A public reply sends customer email, but the workflow does not require confirmation of visibility or content.
remediation.suggestion: Show the ticket, requester, visibility, and final message for confirmation before sending a public reply.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Zendesk connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `zendesk`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- LIST uses `page`/`per_page` pagination, NOT offset-based; check `next_page` in response
- Maximum 100 results per page; iterate with page numbers until `next_page` is null
- `description`: Ticket body (for creation; becomes first comment)
- Use `safe_update` with `updated_stamp` to prevent concurrent modification conflicts
- `description` is only used on creation; use REPLY_ZENDESK_TICKET to add comments after creation
- `public`: Boolean; true for public reply, false for internal note
- `author_id`: Author user ID (defaults to authenticated user)
- Set `public: false` for internal notes visible only to agents
- `query`: Search string (matches name, email, phone, etc.)
- Check `next_page` URL in response; null means last page
- Use `safe_update: true` with `updated_stamp` (ISO 8601) to prevent conflicts
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
3. Use user ID as assignee_id in ticket creation/update

content.value_statement: Manual Zendesk updates make routine support work slow and inconsistent. This skill coordinates ticket, user, reply, and organization tasks through Rube MCP.
actual_capabilities: Connects to an authenticated Zendesk account through Rube MCP.
Lists tickets with page-based pagination and retrieves complete ticket details.
Creates, updates, assigns, closes, and deletes Zendesk tickets.
Adds public replies or internal notes to existing tickets.
Searches for users and creates users with supported Zendesk roles.
Lists, creates, retrieves, counts, and updates organizations.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Zendesk authorization.
Depends on current Composio tool schemas and must search for them before each workflow.
Available actions depend on Zendesk plan features and authenticated user permissions.
Zendesk rate limits and pagination constrain large operations.

use_cases.title: Triage a Support Queue
use_cases.description: Review current tickets, inspect details, assign owners, and update priorities or statuses.

use_cases.title: Maintain Support Records
use_cases.description: Find users, create missing records, and keep organization details and tags current.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Escalation Work
use_cases.description: Add internal notes, prepare customer replies, and move tickets through the correct lifecycle states.

prompt_templates.title: List Recent Tickets
prompt_templates.prompt: List the 25 most recently updated Zendesk tickets. Show ID, subject, priority, status, requester, and assignee.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Ticket Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Open Zendesk ticket [ticket ID], summarize its current state, and draft a reply. Do not send until I confirm visibility and text.

prompt_templates.title: Update Assignment Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Zendesk user matching [name or email]. Show matches, then update ticket [ticket ID] using safe_update after I select an assignee.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Organizations and Tickets
prompt_templates.prompt: Review all Zendesk organizations using pagination. Identify incomplete organization records and related urgent tickets, but make no changes without confirmation.

output_examples.input: List the five latest urgent tickets.
output: Ticket 8421: Login outage, open, assigned to Maya Chen.
Ticket 8417: Payment retry failure, pending, assigned to Devon Lee.
Three additional urgent tickets are available in the requested summary.

output_examples.input: Draft an internal note for ticket 8421.
output_examples.output: Prepared internal note for ticket 8421: Engineering is reviewing authentication logs. No customer message was sent.
Ticket 8421 is currently open. The proposed change to solved is ready for confirmation before execution.

best_practices: Search Rube tools before each workflow so every call uses the current schema.
Fetch current ticket data and use safe_update with updated_stamp before changing fields.
Confirm ticket identity, message visibility, and final text before customer-visible or irreversible actions.
anti_patterns: Do not delete tickets without explicit confirmation of the ticket ID and subject.
Do not replace tags without first fetching and merging the existing values.
Do not create privileged users or mark email as verified without authorization and confirmation.

faq.question: What connection does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the Rube MCP endpoint and an active Zendesk connection authorized through the returned authentication link.

faq.question: Can it search Zendesk tickets?
faq.answer: It can list tickets with pagination and retrieve a specific ticket by ID.

faq.question: Can it send public replies?
faq.answer: Yes. Public replies can email requesters, so confirm the ticket, visibility, and final message before sending.

faq.question: How does it prevent conflicting updates?
faq.answer: Use safe_update with the ticket updated_stamp. Zendesk returns a conflict when the ticket changed after that timestamp.

faq.question: Can it manage users and organizations?
faq.answer: Yes. It can search or create users and list, retrieve, create, count, or update organizations.

faq.question: What happens when a ticket is deleted?
faq.answer: Deletion is permanent and cannot be reversed through the API. Closing the ticket is usually the safer alternative.
